Capabilities.description: v1.1 hello.capabilities. Absent = plain v1 client: only the V1_COMMAND_KINDS are offered to it.
Capabilities.title: Capabilities

ClipMetadata.description: A clip uploaded by a student (binary HTTP, never JSON/base64). Storage/playback: T03.
ClipMetadata.title: ClipMetadata

DeviceStatus.description: Last `status` of a student + the server's view of it (v1 §4: server may force grey).
DeviceStatus.title: DeviceStatus

ExamPolicy.description:
What the student app opens and allows. `welcome.exam` carries the v1 subset (exam_id, title, mode,
allowed_urls, allowed_apps, instructions_ru); the rest is v1.1 / T04.
ExamPolicy.title: ExamPolicy

Incident.description: Latest state of one episode as reported by the student app (A05 fusion on the student PC).
Incident.title: Incident

ObservationEvent.description: One event as received from a student (persisted, deduplicated).
ObservationEvent.title: ObservationEvent

StudentCard.description:
One card of the class panel. FLAT, with the qorgau.class.v1 names (hello identity + status §3.1) that the T02
REAL adapter reads, plus the server's view (answers T02 request 1). `zone` is the effective zone: the server forces
grey for offline / stale status / camera != ok (v1 §4); the student's own value stays in `zone_reported`.
StudentCard.title: StudentCard

TError.description: Answer to a rejected teacher->server message on /ws/teacher (the connection stays open).
TError.title: TError

TFeatureEvent.description: Generic channel for mounted features (T03 history changes, T04 exam/command views, T05 audio).
TFeatureEvent.title: TFeatureEvent

TPreview.description: Preview METADATA; fetch the JPEG from `url`. `jpeg_b64` only with ?inline_previews=1 (legacy v1 panel).
TPreview.title: TPreview

TeacherAudioSignal.description: Teacher -> server over /ws/teacher (relayed to exactly one student; v1 §6).
TeacherAudioSignal.title: TeacherAudioSignal
